integration_issues.flow: POS Clínica sale with Fenilefrina 2.5% gotas
integration_issues.issue: POST /api/ventas returned 400 'Stock insuficiente para Fenilefrina 2.5% gotas' even though the card shows 15 (the product list shows 43 und). Lot-level stock in Dispensario doesn't match the stock shown on the card. Looks like a pre-existing data or lot problem, not caused by the IVA change.

action_items: Optional: the product Excel template/import (Productos.js lines ~409, 423, 1422) still lists the 'afecto_iva' column. Remove it there too for consistency with the form.
Optional: look into why Fenilefrina's card stock (15) doesn't match its lot stock in Dispensario (sale rejected as insufficient).
critical_code_review_comments: PuntoVenta.js calcularTotales: total = subtotal - descGlobal and ignores descItems. That is correct today because item.descuento is always 0, but if per-item discounts are added later, keep it in line with the backend (item_subtotal already subtracts item.descuento).

PuntoVenta.js line 372: adding the same product again recomputes subtotal without subtracting item.descuento, while actualizarCantidad (line 420) does subtract it. This is inconsistent, but harmless while descuento=0.
The margin % in Productos is calculated on the IVA-included sale price. Business may want margin on the net price (precio/1.12).
